idea: Bound each reciprocal term below by a linear expression obtained from a nonnegative square. Adding the three bounds gives the desired inequality.
proof:
have hs : 0 < x + y + z := by positivity
  have hxy : 0 < x + y := by positivity
  have hyz : 0 < y + z := by positivity
  have hzx : 0 < z + x := by positivity
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ 2 / (x + y) - 6 / (x + y + z) +
      (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (x + y) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ (x + y - 2 * z) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (x + y) * (x + y + z) ^ 2) := by positivity
    have heq : (x + y - 2 * z) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (x + y) * (x + y + z) ^ 2) =
        2 / (x + y) - 6 / (x + y + z) +
          (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (x + y) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hxy, ne_of_gt hs] <;> ring
    rw [← heq]
    exact hp
  have h₂ : 0 ≤ 2 / (y + z) - 6 / (x + y + z) +
      (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (y + z) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ (y + z - 2 * x) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (y + z) * (x + y + z) ^ 2) := by positivity
    have heq : (y + z - 2 * x) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (y + z) * (x + y + z) ^ 2) =
        2 / (y + z) - 6 / (x + y + z) +
          (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (y + z) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hyz, ne_of_gt hs] <;> ring
    rw [← heq]
    exact hp
  have h₃ : 0 ≤ 2 / (z + x) - 6 / (x + y + z) +
      (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (z + x) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ (z + x - 2 * y) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (z + x) * (x + y + z) ^ 2) := by positivity
    have heq : (z + x - 2 * y) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (z + x) * (x + y + z) ^ 2) =
        2 / (z + x) - 6 / (x + y + z) +
          (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (z + x) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hzx, ne_of_gt hs] <;> ring
    rw [← heq]
    exact hp
  have hc : (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (x + y) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 +
      (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (y + z) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 +
      (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (z + x) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 =
      9 / (x + y + z) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hs] <;> ring
  linarith
insight_proof:
have hs : 0 < x + y + z := by positivity
  have hxy : 0 < x + y := by positivity
  have hp : 0 ≤ (x + y - 2 * z) ^ 2 /
      (2 * (x + y) * (x + y + z) ^ 2) := by positivity
  have heq : (x + y - 2 * z) ^ 2 /
      (2 * (x + y) * (x + y + z) ^ 2) =
      2 / (x + y) - 6 / (x + y + z) +
        (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (x + y) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hxy, ne_of_gt hs] <;> ring
  rw [← heq]
  exact hp
